  5. {"Webhooks"}

{"Receive events with webhooks"}

{"Workspace sends a signed HTTP request to your endpoint whenever something changes in a workspace, so your app can react without polling."}

{"Overview"}

{"Create an endpoint in the dashboard, pick the events you care about, and Workspace starts delivering them right away. Each request carries a signature so you can confirm it came from us."}

{"Webhooks are available on every plan. Test mode events use a separate signing secret."}

{"Prepare TypeScript"}

{"The verifier checks signatures and returns typed events. Add TypeScript with your package manager."}

{"How delivery works"}

{"Events are signed and queued as soon as they happen. Your endpoint has ten seconds to answer with a 2xx status before the attempt counts as failed."}

{"Verify signatures"}

{"Read the raw request body, then pass it to the SDK together with the"} {" "} {"workspace-signature"} {" header."}

{"app/webhooks/route.ts"}

{"Event payload"}

{"Every event shares the same envelope."}

{"Event payload fields"}
{"Field"} {"Type"} {"Description"}
{"id"} {"string"} {"Unique event ID. Use it to ignore duplicate deliveries."}
{"type"} {"string"} {"Event name, such as note.published or member.invited."}
{"created"} {"number"} {"Unix timestamp in seconds when the event happened."}
{"data"} {"object"} {"The resource that changed, in its state after the event."}
{"attempt"} {"number"} {"Delivery attempt, starting at 1 and increasing on retry."}

{"Retries"}

{"Failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff for up to three days. Use the event "} {"id"} {" to skip events you have already handled."}

{"After 15 failed attempts we pause the endpoint and email the workspace owners."}
